diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says C, datasheet reading says SCL
diffs.evidence: The Adafruit pinout guide for product 4980 lists the header silkscreen as VIN, 3, -, C, D, INT and says 'This is the I2C clock pin. Connect to your microcontroller I2C clock line', so the fourth pin is labelled C and is SCL; the second reading only used the generic name SCL for the same pin (the model fn is i2c.scl).

diffs.diff: header pin 5: part says D, datasheet reading says SDA
diffs.evidence: The Adafruit pinout guide for product 4980 says of the fifth header pin, labelled D, 'This is the I2C data pin. Connect to your microcontroller I2C data line', so D is SDA under its silkscreen name; the second reading used the generic name SDA for the same pin (the model fn is i2c.sda).
